description: One model's discount for one month of a manufacturer's discount sheet: the percentage off list price, the versions it excludes and any extra incentive (trade-in, scrappage, stock or registration bonus).

channel.description: When the sheet splits a brand's table by sales channel.

model.description: The model line as the sheet writes it, codes and series included.

discountPercent.description: Percent off the list price of the base vehicle and options. Null when the sheet gives only an extra incentive.

excludedVersions.description: Versions the discount does not apply to, as written.

extraIncentive.description: Any extra on top: trade-in, scrappage, stock or registration bonus, as written.
